key_insight: CORTEX adds structured, stage-by-stage reasoning traces to 3D chest CT questions so MLLMs can show how they reach answers, not just the final answer.
clinical_relevance: This makes chest CT AI outputs more interpretable and easier to verify against scan evidence, which is important for trustworthy radiology workflows.
method: Built CORTEX on CT-RATE with 76,177 validated reasoning traces.
Organized each item into four stages: task understanding, visual observation, diagnostic reasoning, and answer synthesis.
Used frontier LLMs to generate traces, then filtered them with rubric-based checks and expert radiologist review.
evidence_signal: The benchmark spans open-ended VQA, closed-ended VQA, and report generation, with stage-level evaluation designed jointly with clinicians.
watch_item: Because the reasoning traces are LLM-generated and then filtered, performance may still depend on the quality of the generated explanations and how well they transfer to real-world clinical use.
paper_title: CORTEX: A Structured Reasoning Benchmark for Trustworthy 3D Chest CT MLLMs
